relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that EA at A-fiber intensity alleviates inflammatory pain by recruiting GABAergic neurons in the spinal dorsal horn, thereby enhancing inhibitory tone on spinal nociceptive transmission.

relationships.subject: dorsal horn GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Crucially, chemogenetic activation of GABAergic dorsal horn neurons produced robust analgesic effects

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA at A-fiber intensity significantly attenuated noxious stimulus-induced neuronal c-Fos expression in the superficial dorsal horn

key_findings: A-fiber intensity electroacupuncture relieves CFA inflammatory pain by recruiting spinal dorsal horn GABAergic neurons.
Optogenetic inhibition of GABAergic neurons reverses EA analgesia.
